stages.name: proj_inventory
stages.query:
SELECT *, module || '::' || CASE WHEN class_name IS NULL THEN name ELSE class_name || '.' || name END AS id,
 module || '.' || CASE WHEN class_name IS NULL THEN name ELSE class_name || '.' || name END AS fqname
 FROM (SELECT __path,__start,__end,name,class_name,return_annotation,class_start,body_start, replace(rx_replace(__path, '/__init__\.py$|\.py$', ''), '/', '.') AS module, CASE WHEN class_name IS NULL THEN 'function' ELSE 'method' END AS kind FROM py_functions
 UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,__end,name,NULL,NULL,NULL,body_start,replace(rx_replace(__path, '/__init__\.py$|\.py$', ''), '/', '.'),'class' FROM py_classes)

stages.name: proj_declarations
stages.query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT *,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY __start DESC,__path) AS selected FROM proj_inventory) WHERE selected=1

stages.name: proj_parameters
stages.query:
SELECT p.*, d.id AS symbol FROM py_parameters p JOIN proj_declarations d ON d.__path=p.__path AND d.__start=p.owner
 WHERE d.class_name IS NULL OR p.name NOT IN ('self','cls')

stages.name: proj_annotation_names
stages.query:
SELECT d.id AS symbol,a.name FROM py_return_annotations a JOIN proj_declarations d ON d.__path=a.__path AND d.__start=a.owner
 UNION SELECT p.symbol,a.name FROM py_parameter_annotations a JOIN proj_parameters p ON p.__path=a.__path AND p.__start=a.parameter

stages.name: proj_imports
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE
 tokens(path,ordinal,top,base,item,rest,position) AS (
 SELECT __path,__start,top,base,'',rx_replace(items,'#[^\n]*','') || ',',0 FROM py_imports
 UNION SELECT path,ordinal,top,base,trim(substr(rest,1,instr(rest,',')-1),' ()' || char(10) || char(13)),substr(rest,instr(rest,',')+1),position+1 FROM tokens WHERE rest<>''),
 parts AS (SELECT *,rx_extract(item,'^(\S+)',1) AS original, rx_extract(item,'\s+as\s+(\S+)$',1) AS alias,
 replace(rx_replace(path,'/__init__\.py$|\.py$',''),'/','.') AS module FROM tokens WHERE item<>''),
 relative(path,ordinal,top,base,original,alias,module,prefix,remaining,position) AS (
 SELECT path,ordinal,top,base,original,alias,module,CASE WHEN path LIKE '%/__init__.py' THEN module ELSE rx_replace(module,'\.?[^.]+$','') END,
 coalesce(length(base)-length(ltrim(base,'.'))-1,-1),position FROM parts
 UNION SELECT path,ordinal,top,base,original,alias,module,rx_replace(prefix,'\.?[^.]+$',''),remaining-1,position FROM relative WHERE remaining>0),
 resolved AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN base IS NULL THEN original WHEN base NOT LIKE '.%' THEN base || '.' || original
 ELSE CASE WHEN prefix='' THEN '' ELSE prefix || '.' END || CASE WHEN ltrim(base,'.')='' THEN '' ELSE ltrim(base,'.') || '.' END || original END AS target,
 coalesce(alias,CASE WHEN base IS NULL THEN rx_extract(original,'^[^.]+',0) ELSE original END) AS name FROM relative WHERE remaining<=0)
 SELECT path,ordinal,top,module,name,target,CASE WHEN base IS NULL THEN 'module' ELSE 'symbol' END AS kind
 FROM (SELECT *,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY module,name,base IS NULL ORDER BY ordinal DESC,position DESC,path) AS selected FROM resolved WHERE original<>'*') WHERE selected=1

stages.name: proj_resolved_names
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE names(fqname,symbol) AS (
 SELECT fqname,id FROM proj_declarations UNION
 SELECT i.module || '.' || i.name,n.symbol FROM names n CROSS JOIN proj_imports i ON i.target=n.fqname
 WHERE i.kind='symbol' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proj_declarations d WHERE d.fqname=i.module || '.' || i.name))
 SELECT * FROM names

stages.name: proj_base_edges
stages.query:
SELECT d.id AS owner,b.id AS base,r.__start AS ordinal FROM py_bases r JOIN proj_declarations d ON d.__path=r.__path AND d.__start=r.owner
 JOIN proj_declarations b ON b.kind='class' AND b.id=coalesce(
 (SELECT c.id FROM proj_imports i JOIN proj_declarations c ON c.fqname=i.target AND c.kind='class'
 WHERE i.kind='symbol' AND i.module=d.module AND i.name=trim(rx_replace(rx_replace(r.name,'(?s)\[.*$',''),'^.*\.','')) ORDER BY c.id LIMIT 1),
 (SELECT c.id FROM proj_declarations c WHERE c.module=d.module AND c.kind='class' AND c.name=trim(rx_replace(rx_replace(r.name,'(?s)\[.*$',''),'^.*\.','')) ORDER BY c.id LIMIT 1),
 (SELECT min(c.id) FROM proj_declarations c WHERE c.kind='class' AND c.name=trim(rx_replace(rx_replace(r.name,'(?s)\[.*$',''),'^.*\.','')) HAVING count(*)=1))

stages.name: proj_hierarchy
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE walk(owner,base,depth,route,seen) AS (
 SELECT id,id,0,'',',' || id || ',' FROM proj_declarations WHERE kind='class' UNION
 SELECT w.owner,e.base,w.depth+1,w.route || printf('%012d.',e.ordinal),w.seen || e.base || ',' FROM walk w JOIN proj_base_edges e ON e.owner=w.base WHERE instr(w.seen,',' || e.base || ',')=0)
 SELECT owner,base,depth,route FROM (SELECT *,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY owner,base ORDER BY depth,route) AS selected FROM walk) WHERE selected=1

stages.name: proj_public_methods
stages.query:
SELECT owner,name,symbol FROM (
 SELECT h.owner,d.name,d.id AS symbol,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY h.owner,d.name ORDER BY h.depth,h.route,d.id) AS selected
 FROM proj_hierarchy h JOIN proj_declarations c ON c.id=h.base JOIN proj_declarations d ON d.module=c.module AND d.class_name=c.name
 WHERE d.kind='method' AND substr(d.name,1,1)<>'_' AND d.name NOT IN ('__aenter__','__aexit__','__enter__','__exit__','__init__','__repr__','__str__','authorize_internal_access','disable_thread_affinity_checks','get_thread_checks_disabled','set_disable_thread_checks','validate_legacy_delegates','versioned_read','versioned_write')
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_decorators x WHERE x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start AND rx_matches(x.name,'property$|\.setter$|\.deleter$'))) WHERE selected=1

stages.name: proj_explicit_exports
stages.query: SELECT *,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY __path ORDER BY __start) AS selected FROM py_all

stages.name: proj_export_names
stages.query:
SELECT path,module,name,target FROM proj_imports WHERE top IS NOT NULL AND kind='symbol' AND rx_matches(path,'^data_layer/[^/]+\.py$')
 UNION ALL SELECT __path,module,name,fqname FROM proj_declarations WHERE class_name IS NULL AND rx_matches(__path,'^data_layer/[^/]+\.py$')

stages.name: proj_exported_roots
stages.query:
SELECT DISTINCT e.path,e.module AS export_module,e.name AS export_name,n.symbol FROM proj_export_names e JOIN proj_resolved_names n ON n.fqname=e.target
 LEFT JOIN proj_explicit_exports a ON a.__path=e.path AND a.selected=1
 WHERE substr(e.name,1,1)<>'_' AND (a.__path IS NULL OR (a.array IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_all_names v WHERE v.__path=e.path AND v.owner=a.__start AND v.name=e.name)))

stages.name: dc__dead_traits
stages.query:
SELECT d.*,rx_replace(d.name,'_(?:async|lazy)$','') AS base_name,CASE WHEN class_name IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE module || '::' || class_name END AS class_id,
 CASE WHEN kind='class' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_bases b WHERE b.__path=d.__path AND b.owner=d.__start AND instr(b.name,'ABC')>0)
 ELSE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_decorators x WHERE x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start AND rx_matches(x.name,'abstractmethod$')) END AS abstract,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_decorators x WHERE x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start AND rx_matches(x.name,'property$|\.setter$|\.deleter$')) AS property,
 rx_matches(name,'^__.*__$') OR name IN ('main','pytest_configure','pytest_collection_modifyitems') OR
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_decorators x WHERE x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start AND rx_matches(x.name,'validator$|overload$')) AS implicit,
 rx_matches(name,'Protocol$') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_bases b WHERE b.__path=d.__path AND b.owner=d.__start AND instr(b.name,'Protocol')>0) AS protocol,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_bases b WHERE b.__path=d.__path AND b.owner=d.__start AND instr(b.name,'Protocol')>0) AS structural_protocol
 FROM proj_declarations d

stages.name: dc__class_names
stages.query:
SELECT r.module,r.name,coalesce(
 (SELECT c.id FROM proj_imports i JOIN proj_resolved_names n ON n.fqname=i.target JOIN proj_declarations c ON c.id=n.symbol AND c.kind='class' WHERE i.kind='symbol' AND i.module=r.module AND i.name=r.name ORDER BY c.id LIMIT 1),
 (SELECT c.id FROM proj_declarations c WHERE c.kind='class' AND c.module=r.module AND c.name=r.name ORDER BY c.id LIMIT 1)) AS target
 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT d.module,a.name FROM proj_annotation_names a JOIN proj_declarations d ON d.id=a.symbol) r

stages.name: dc__module_names
stages.query:
SELECT DISTINCT replace(rx_replace(__path, '/__init__\.py$|\.py$', ''), '/', '.') AS module,n.name FROM dc__raw_module_names n
 WHERE n.control IS NOT NULL OR n.nested_class IS NOT NULL OR (
 (n.decorated_function IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_functions f WHERE f.__path=n.__path AND f.__start=n.decorated_function AND f.class_name IS NOT NULL))
 AND (n.decorated_class IS NULL OR n.class_body IS NOT NULL)
 AND (n.class IS NULL OR n.class_body IS NOT NULL)
 AND (n.function IS NULL OR (n.default_value IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_functions f WHERE f.__path=n.__path AND f.__start=n.function AND f.class_name IS NOT NULL))))

stages.name: dc__imported_modules
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE modules(module) AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN kind='module' THEN target ELSE rx_replace(target,'\.?[^.]+$','') END FROM proj_imports
 UNION SELECT rx_replace(module,'\.?[^.]+$','') FROM modules WHERE instr(module,'.')>0)
 SELECT DISTINCT module FROM modules WHERE module<>''

cases.true: SELECT symbol FROM proj_exported_roots UNION SELECT p.symbol FROM proj_public_methods p JOIN proj_exported_roots r ON r.symbol=p.owner UNION SELECT '@module:' || module FROM dc__imported_modules
cases.false: SELECT symbol FROM proj_exported_roots UNION SELECT p.symbol FROM proj_public_methods p JOIN proj_exported_roots r ON r.symbol=p.owner UNION SELECT '@module:' || module FROM dc__imported_modules UNION SELECT n.symbol FROM dc__raw_dynamic_imports d JOIN proj_resolved_names n ON n.fqname=rx_extract(d.entry,'(?:\bimport_module|\bload_python_module|\bimportlib\.import_module)\(\s*[''\"](?P<module>[^''\"]+)[''\"]\s*\)\.(?P<attr>[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)',1) || '.' || rx_extract(d.entry,'(?:\bimport_module|\bload_python_module|\bimportlib\.import_module)\(\s*[''\"](?P<module>[^''\"]+)[''\"]\s*\)\.(?P<attr>[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)',2)

stages.name: dc__reach_edges
stages.query:
SELECT s.id AS source,t.id AS target FROM reference_edges e
 JOIN proj_declarations s ON s.__path=e.__path AND s.__start=e.__start JOIN proj_declarations t ON t.__path=e.target_path AND t.__start=e.target_start
 UNION SELECT owner,symbol FROM proj_public_methods
 UNION SELECT h.owner,m.id FROM proj_hierarchy h JOIN proj_declarations c ON c.id=h.base JOIN proj_declarations m ON m.module=c.module AND m.class_name=c.name
 WHERE m.name IN ('__new__','__init__','__init_subclass__','__post_init__','__set_name__','__class_getitem__')
 UNION SELECT owner,base FROM proj_base_edges UNION SELECT base,owner FROM proj_base_edges
 UNION SELECT d.id,s.id FROM dc__dead_traits d CROSS JOIN proj_declarations s ON s.module=d.module
 AND s.name IN (d.base_name,d.base_name || '_async',d.base_name || '_lazy') AND s.id<>d.id WHERE d.kind='function'
 UNION SELECT d.id,s.id FROM dc__dead_traits d CROSS JOIN proj_declarations s ON s.id IN
 (d.class_id || '.' || d.base_name,d.class_id || '.' || d.base_name || '_async',d.class_id || '.' || d.base_name || '_lazy') AND s.id<>d.id WHERE d.kind='method'
 UNION SELECT a.symbol,c.target FROM proj_annotation_names a JOIN proj_declarations d ON d.id=a.symbol JOIN dc__class_names c ON c.module=d.module AND c.name=a.name WHERE c.target IS NOT NULL
 UNION SELECT d.id,'@module:' || d.module FROM proj_declarations d
 UNION SELECT '@module:' || n.module,d.id FROM dc__module_names n JOIN proj_declarations d ON d.module=n.module AND d.name=n.name
 UNION SELECT '@module:' || n.module,d.id FROM dc__module_names n JOIN proj_imports i ON i.module=n.module AND i.name=n.name AND i.kind='symbol' JOIN proj_declarations d ON d.fqname=i.target
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proj_declarations local WHERE local.module=n.module AND local.name=n.name)
 UNION SELECT m.id,other.id FROM dc__dead_traits m JOIN dc__dead_traits c ON c.id=m.class_id AND c.structural_protocol
 JOIN dc__dead_traits other ON other.kind='method' AND other.name=m.name AND other.class_id<>m.class_id

stages.name: dc__reachable
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE flow(node,dispatch) AS (
 SELECT symbol,NULL FROM dc__dead_roots
 UNION SELECT e.target,NULL FROM flow f JOIN dc__reach_edges e ON e.source=f.node WHERE f.dispatch IS NULL
 UNION SELECT b.owner,f.node FROM flow f JOIN dc__dead_traits m ON m.id=f.node JOIN proj_base_edges b ON b.base=m.class_id WHERE f.dispatch IS NULL AND m.kind='method'
 UNION SELECT b.owner,f.dispatch FROM flow f JOIN proj_base_edges b ON b.base=f.node WHERE f.dispatch IS NOT NULL
 UNION SELECT b.base,f.dispatch FROM flow f JOIN proj_base_edges b ON b.owner=f.node JOIN dc__dead_traits original ON original.id=f.dispatch WHERE f.dispatch IS NOT NULL AND b.base<>original.class_id
 UNION SELECT m.id,NULL FROM flow f JOIN dc__dead_traits original ON original.id=f.dispatch JOIN proj_declarations c ON c.id=f.node JOIN dc__dead_traits m ON m.module=c.module AND m.class_name=c.name AND m.name=original.name WHERE f.dispatch IS NOT NULL)
 SELECT DISTINCT node AS symbol FROM flow WHERE dispatch IS NULL

stages.name: dc__annotation_reachable
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE unique_classes(name,target) AS (SELECT name,min(id) FROM proj_declarations WHERE kind='class' GROUP BY name HAVING count(*)=1),
 annotated(symbol) AS (SELECT symbol FROM dc__reachable UNION SELECT c.target FROM annotated r JOIN proj_annotation_names a ON a.symbol=r.symbol JOIN unique_classes c ON c.name=a.name)
 SELECT symbol FROM annotated

stages.name: dc__high_confidence
stages.query:
SELECT d.* FROM dc__dead_traits d
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dc__annotation_reachable r WHERE r.symbol=d.id)
 AND NOT rx_matches(d.module,'^(?:api|data_layer)\.') AND NOT d.implicit
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proj_imports i WHERE i.kind='symbol' AND i.target=d.fqname)
 AND NOT (d.kind='class' AND d.protocol)
 AND NOT (d.kind<>'class' AND (d.abstract OR d.property OR instr(d.name,'_lower_')=1 OR instr(lower(d.name),'register')>0
   OR rx_matches(d.name,'^_create_.*_(?:connection|validator|factory)$')
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dc__dead_traits c WHERE c.id=d.class_id AND c.protocol)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proj_hierarchy h JOIN dc__dead_traits c ON c.id=h.base JOIN dc__dead_traits m ON m.module=c.module AND m.class_name=c.name AND m.name=d.name AND m.abstract WHERE h.owner=d.class_id AND h.depth>0)))
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proj_hierarchy h JOIN dc__dead_traits b ON b.id=h.base JOIN dc__annotation_reachable r ON r.symbol=b.id
   WHERE h.owner=CASE WHEN d.kind='class' THEN d.id ELSE d.class_id END AND h.depth>0 AND
   (b.abstract OR (instr(b.name,'ABC')>0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proj_base_edges e WHERE e.owner=h.owner AND e.base=b.id))))

cases.true:
SELECT __path AS path,__start AS start_byte,__end AS end_byte,id AS symbol,category FROM (SELECT d.*, 'high_confidence_functions' AS category FROM dc__high_confidence d WHERE kind<>'class'
 UNION ALL SELECT d.*,'high_confidence_intents' FROM dc__high_confidence d WHERE kind='class' AND (rx_matches(d.name,'Intent$') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_bases b WHERE b.__path=d.__path AND b.owner=d.__start AND instr(b.name,'ServerPlanStep')>0))
 UNION ALL SELECT d.*,'high_confidence_grammar_classes' FROM dc__high_confidence d WHERE kind='class' AND (NOT d.protocol AND (instr(d.__path,'/l2100_sql_grammar/')>0 OR rx_matches(d.name,'Grammar$|^Sql') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_bases b WHERE b.__path=d.__path AND b.owner=d.__start AND rx_matches(b.name,'Sql|Grammar'))))
 UNION ALL SELECT d.*,'high_confidence_other_classes' FROM dc__high_confidence d WHERE kind='class' AND NOT (rx_matches(d.name,'Intent$') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_bases b WHERE b.__path=d.__path AND b.owner=d.__start AND instr(b.name,'ServerPlanStep')>0)) AND NOT (NOT d.protocol AND (instr(d.__path,'/l2100_sql_grammar/')>0 OR rx_matches(d.name,'Grammar$|^Sql') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_bases b WHERE b.__path=d.__path AND b.owner=d.__start AND rx_matches(b.name,'Sql|Grammar')))))
cases.false:
SELECT __path AS path,__start AS start_byte,__end AS end_byte,id AS symbol,category FROM (SELECT d.*, 'high_confidence_functions' AS category FROM dc__high_confidence d WHERE kind<>'class'
 UNION ALL SELECT d.*,'high_confidence_intents' FROM dc__high_confidence d WHERE kind='class' AND (rx_matches(d.name,'Intent$') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_bases b WHERE b.__path=d.__path AND b.owner=d.__start AND instr(b.name,'ServerPlanStep')>0))
 UNION ALL SELECT d.*,'high_confidence_grammar_classes' FROM dc__high_confidence d WHERE kind='class' AND (NOT d.protocol AND (instr(d.__path,'/l2100_sql_grammar/')>0 OR rx_matches(d.name,'Grammar$|^Sql') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_bases b WHERE b.__path=d.__path AND b.owner=d.__start AND rx_matches(b.name,'Sql|Grammar'))))
 UNION ALL SELECT d.*,'high_confidence_other_classes' FROM dc__high_confidence d WHERE kind='class' AND NOT (rx_matches(d.name,'Intent$') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_bases b WHERE b.__path=d.__path AND b.owner=d.__start AND instr(b.name,'ServerPlanStep')>0)) AND NOT (NOT d.protocol AND (instr(d.__path,'/l2100_sql_grammar/')>0 OR rx_matches(d.name,'Grammar$|^Sql') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_bases b WHERE b.__path=d.__path AND b.owner=d.__start AND rx_matches(b.name,'Sql|Grammar'))))) WHERE instr(__path,'impl/browser/')<>1

stages.name: ef__traits
stages.query:
SELECT d.*,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_decorators x WHERE (x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start) AND rx_matches(x.name,'(?:legacy_sync|legacy_module_sync|direct_legacy_module_sync)$')) AS legacy_sync,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_decorators x WHERE (x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start) AND rx_matches(x.name,'(?:legacy_async|legacy_module_async|direct_legacy_module_async)$')) AS legacy_async,(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_decorators x WHERE (x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start) AND rx_matches(x.name,'pure_lazy|apply_lazy_to_public_lazy_methods|(?:^|\.)lazy$')) OR (substr(d.name,1,1)<>'_' AND rx_matches(d.name,'_lazy$') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_decorators x WHERE (x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start OR x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.class_start) AND rx_matches(x.name,'pure_lazy|apply_lazy_to_public_lazy_methods|(?:^|\.)lazy$')))) AS lazy_decorated,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_decorators x WHERE (x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start OR x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.class_start) AND rx_matches(x.name,'(?:^|\.)(?:internal_api|private_api|private_public_api)$')) AS private_api,(NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_decorators x WHERE (x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start) AND rx_matches(x.name,'abstractmethod$')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_decorators x WHERE (x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start OR x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.class_start) AND rx_matches(x.name,'(?:^|\.)(?:internal_api|private_api|private_public_api)$')) AND NOT (d.kind='function' AND d.__path IN ('l2055_lazy_result/lazy_reads.py','l2055_lazy_result/lazy_writes.py','l2055_lazy_result/transform.py') AND instr(d.name,'lazy_')=1 AND (rx_matches(d.name,'_lazy$') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proj_annotation_names a WHERE a.symbol=d.id AND lower(a.name) IN ('lazyresult','lazyseq','serverplan')))) AND NOT coalesce((d.__path IN ('l2055_lazy_result/execution_context.py','l2055_lazy_result/lazy_result.py','l2055_lazy_result/lazy_seq.py','l2055_lazy_result/transform.py') AND d.class_name IN ('BatchContext','EagerContext','LazyResult','LazySeq','OnAccessContext')),0) AND NOT coalesce((d.class_name IS NOT NULL AND (trim(d.return_annotation,' ' || char(39) || char(34))=d.class_name OR instr(trim(d.return_annotation,' ' || char(39) || char(34)),d.class_name || '[')=1)),0) AND ((rx_replace(d.name,'_(?:lazy|async|sync)$','') IN ('aggregate','commit','commit_branch','count','create_branch','cursor_paginate','cursor_paginate_with_total','delete_by_id','delete_by_key','delete_by_key_many','delete_many','execute','execute_one','exists','find_object_branches','find_object_revisions','first','fts_search','get_history','graph','graph_query','insert','insert_many','insert_many_raw','keyset_paginate','keyset_paginate_with_total','query','query_unfiltered','read','read_version','rollback','search','select_at_revision','select_many','select_one','table_exists','traverse','update','update_by_key','update_by_key_many','update_many','upsert','upsert_many','vector_search','write','write_version') AND (rx_matches(d.__path,'(?:/graph_query|/schema_transaction|/transaction|/versioned_transactions)') OR rx_matches(lower(coalesce(d.class_name,'')),'(?:connection|query|schematransaction|transaction|versioned)') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proj_annotation_names a WHERE a.symbol=d.id AND lower(a.name) IN ('databaseconnection','lazyresult','lazyseq','readtransaction','serverplan','versioneddatabaseconnection','versionedreadtransaction','versionedwritetransaction','writetransaction')))) OR (rx_matches(d.name,'_lazy$') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM proj_annotation_names a WHERE a.symbol=d.id AND lower(a.name) IN ('lazyresult','lazyseq','serverplan'))) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_decorators x WHERE (x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start) AND rx_matches(x.name,'(?:legacy_sync|legacy_module_sync|direct_legacy_module_sync)$')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_decorators x WHERE (x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start) AND rx_matches(x.name,'(?:legacy_async|legacy_module_async|direct_legacy_module_async)$')))) AS execution_surface,
 coalesce((SELECT json_group_array(name) FROM (SELECT name FROM proj_parameters p WHERE p.symbol=d.id ORDER BY p.__start,p.__path)),'[]') AS params,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_decorators x WHERE (x.__path=d.__path AND x.owner=d.__start) AND rx_matches(x.name,'(?:^|\.)direct_legacy[^.]*$')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ef__raw_execution_calls e WHERE e.__path=d.__path AND e.owner=d.__start
 AND (e.name IN ('_fetchall','_fetchone','execute','execute_async','execute_fire_and_forget','execute_grammar','execute_grammar_fetchall','execute_grammar_fetchone','execute_raw','fetchall','fetchall_raw','fetchone','fetchone_raw','grammar_effect_lazy','grammar_fetchall','grammar_fetchall_async','grammar_fetchone','grammar_fetchone_async','grammar_row_lazy','grammar_rows_lazy','raw_execute') OR instr(e.name,'execute_grammar')=1 OR instr(e.name,'grammar_fetch')=1)
 AND (rx_matches(e.name,'_lazy$') OR instr(e.name,'lazy_')=1)) AS direct_lazy_wrapper
 FROM proj_declarations d

stages.name: ef__surfaces
stages.query:
SELECT *,CASE WHEN mixed THEN name ELSE rx_replace(name,'_(?:lazy|async|sync)$','') END AS base_name,
 CASE WHEN mixed AND scope='method' THEN '__invalid_mixed_name__' WHEN rx_matches(name,'_lazy$') THEN 'lazy' WHEN rx_matches(name,'_async$') THEN 'async'
 WHEN legacy_async THEN 'async' ELSE 'sync' END AS slot FROM (
 SELECT d.id AS symbol,d.name,d.legacy_async,d.execution_surface,'function' AS scope,r.export_module AS owner,r.export_module || char(0) || r.export_name AS ordinal,
 rx_matches(lower(d.name),'lazy') AND rx_matches(lower(d.name),'async|sync') AS mixed
 FROM proj_exported_roots r JOIN ef__traits d ON d.id=r.symbol WHERE d.kind='function' AND substr(d.name,1,1)<>'_' AND instr(d.__path,'_internal/')<>1
 UNION ALL
 SELECT d.id,d.name,d.legacy_async,d.execution_surface,'method',c.name,d.name,
 rx_matches(lower(d.name),'lazy') AND rx_matches(lower(d.name),'async|sync')
 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM proj_exported_roots) r JOIN ef__traits c ON c.id=r.symbol AND c.kind='class'
 JOIN proj_public_methods p ON p.owner=c.id JOIN ef__traits d ON d.id=p.symbol
 WHERE NOT c.private_api AND NOT d.private_api AND NOT rx_matches(c.name,'Protocol$|^Async')
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM py_bases b WHERE b.__path=c.__path AND b.owner=c.__start AND instr(b.name,'Protocol')>0))

stages.name: ef__slots
stages.query:
SELECT * FROM (
 SELECT *,min(ordinal) OVER (PARTITION BY scope,owner,base_name,slot) AS first_ordinal,
 row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY scope,owner,base_name,slot ORDER BY ordinal DESC,symbol) AS selected
 FROM ef__surfaces WHERE NOT (scope='function' AND mixed)) WHERE selected=1

stages.name: ef__family_groups
stages.query:
SELECT scope,owner,base_name,
 (SELECT symbol FROM ef__slots x WHERE x.scope=s.scope AND x.owner=s.owner AND x.base_name=s.base_name ORDER BY x.first_ordinal,x.slot LIMIT 1) AS exemplar,
 max(CASE WHEN slot='sync' THEN symbol END) AS sync_id,max(CASE WHEN slot='async' THEN symbol END) AS async_id,max(CASE WHEN slot='lazy' THEN symbol END) AS lazy_id,
 max(mixed) AS mixed,max(execution_surface) AS execution_surface,
 (SELECT json_group_array(json_array(slot,symbol)) FROM (SELECT slot,symbol FROM ef__slots x WHERE x.scope=s.scope AND x.owner=s.owner AND x.base_name=s.base_name ORDER BY slot)) AS implementations
 FROM ef__slots s GROUP BY scope,owner,base_name

cases.true:
SELECT g.* FROM ef__family_groups g JOIN ef__traits d ON d.id=g.exemplar WHERE g.mixed OR (NOT ((g.base_name IN ('plan','query','query_unfiltered') AND d.__path IN ('l2050_transaction/transaction.py','l7200_versioned_transactions/versioned_transactions.py') AND g.owner IN ('ReadTransaction','WriteTransaction','LazyVersionedReadTransaction','LazyVersionedWriteTransaction'))
 OR (g.owner='CacheTransaction' AND g.base_name IN ('commit','rollback')) OR (g.owner='BaseMigration' AND g.base_name='rollback')
 OR (g.base_name='execute_ddl' AND (g.owner IN ('SchemaTransaction','AsyncSchemaTransaction') OR d.__path='l2000_connection/schema_transaction.py'))
 OR (rx_matches(g.owner,'Connection$') AND g.base_name='table_exists')
 OR (g.sync_id IS NULL AND g.async_id IS NULL AND g.lazy_id IS NOT NULL AND (instr(lower(g.base_name),'bootstrap')>0 OR instr(lower(g.owner),'bootstrap')>0 OR g.base_name IN ('check_ddl_lockdown','column_exists','physical_table_exists_many','seal_table_exists_cache')))
 OR g.owner IN ('LazyVersionedReadTransaction','LazyVersionedWriteTransaction','SyncSessionHandle','AsyncSessionHandle','SyncVersionHandle','AsyncVersionHandle')
 OR rx_matches(g.owner,'^(?:Sync|Async|Lazy).*(?:Transaction|SchemaTransaction|SessionHandle|VersionHandle)$')) AND coalesce(g.execution_surface,0))

 OR g.owner IN ('LazyVersionedReadTransaction','LazyVersionedWriteTransaction','SyncSessionHandle','AsyncSessionHandle','SyncVersionHandle','AsyncVersionHandle')

stages.name: ef__families
stages.query:
SELECT *,json_array(scope,owner,base_name,implementations) AS family FROM (
 SELECT *,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY scope,base_name,implementations ORDER BY owner) AS selected FROM ef__eligible_groups) WHERE mixed OR selected=1

stages.name: ef__triple_violations
stages.query:
SELECT 'invalid_mixed_lazy_execution_name' AS issue,symbol,json_array(scope,owner,base_name,ordinal) AS family FROM ef__surfaces WHERE scope='function' AND mixed
 UNION ALL SELECT 'invalid_mixed_lazy_execution_name',exemplar,family FROM ef__families WHERE mixed
 UNION ALL SELECT 'missing_sync',exemplar,family FROM ef__families WHERE NOT mixed AND sync_id IS NULL AND async_id IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT 'missing_async',exemplar,family FROM ef__families WHERE NOT mixed AND async_id IS NULL AND sync_id IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT 'missing_lazy',exemplar,family FROM ef__families WHERE NOT mixed AND lazy_id IS NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT 'missing_legacy_sync',f.sync_id,f.family FROM ef__families f JOIN ef__traits s ON s.id=f.sync_id JOIN ef__traits l ON l.id=f.lazy_id WHERE NOT f.mixed AND s.params=l.params AND NOT s.legacy_sync
 UNION ALL SELECT 'missing_legacy_async',f.async_id,f.family FROM ef__families f JOIN ef__traits s ON s.id=f.async_id JOIN ef__traits l ON l.id=f.lazy_id WHERE NOT f.mixed AND s.params=l.params AND NOT s.legacy_async
 UNION ALL SELECT 'missing_lazy_decorator',f.lazy_id,f.family FROM ef__families f JOIN ef__traits s ON s.id=f.lazy_id WHERE NOT f.mixed AND NOT s.lazy_decorated
 UNION ALL SELECT 'direct_wrapper_bypasses_lazy_owner',symbol,family FROM (
 SELECT f.family,s.symbol,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY f.family ORDER BY d.__path,d.__start,s.symbol) AS selected
 FROM ef__families f JOIN ef__slots s ON s.scope=f.scope AND s.owner=f.owner AND s.base_name=f.base_name JOIN ef__traits d ON d.id=s.symbol
 WHERE NOT f.mixed AND f.lazy_id IS NOT NULL AND s.slot IN ('sync','async') AND d.direct_lazy_wrapper) WHERE selected=1

stages.name: ef__findings
stages.query: SELECT d.__path AS path,d.__start AS start_byte,d.__end AS end_byte,v.issue,v.family FROM ef__triple_violations v JOIN ef__traits d ON d.id=v.symbol

relational.query:
SELECT 'unreachable-internal-symbols' AS rule,path,start_byte,end_byte,symbol || ':' || category AS detail FROM dc__findings
 UNION ALL SELECT 'exported-families' AS rule,path,start_byte,end_byte,issue || ':' || family AS detail FROM ef__findings
